title: Networking preflight: actionable errors for missing ECR/S3 endpoints + doc links
author: Benji Okafor
body: Title: Networking preflight: actionable errors for missing ECR/S3 endpoints + doc links Context: During pilot installs in locked-down VPCs we repeatedly saw the installer fail with generic image-pull / registry errors. Root cause was usually missing VPC interface endpoints (ECR API/DKR) or missing S3 gateway endpoint route association, but the error surfaced too late and without clear remediation. This PR improves networking preflight error messages so customers get an immediate, actionable diagnosis (what is missing, where to look, and what Terraform module knobs to enable). It also links directly to our Confluence runbook for the canonical checks. What changed: - Added explicit preflight checks for ECR API + ECR DKR endpoint DNS resolution and TCP connectivity (443) with differentiated failure messages (missing endpoint vs private DNS disabled vs SG/NACL route issues). - Added explicit check for S3 gateway endpoint route presence for the private subnets that the installer will use (when running in no-public-egress mode). - Added a single consolidated “Networking requirements summary” block at the end of preflight output with detected VPC/subnet/region and the specific AWS services that failed. - Included Confluence runbook link in failures and in `--help` for `preflight networking` to reduce support loops. - Updated error codes to be stable and grep-friendly (e.g., `NET-0201`, `NET-0202`). User-facing behavior (examples): - Before: `error: failed to pull image ... i/o timeout` - After: `NET-0201: Unable to reach Amazon ECR (api.ecr.<region>.amazonaws.com:443). Likely missing VPC interface endpoint 'com.amazonaws.<region>.ecr.api' OR Private DNS is disabled on the endpoint. Remediation: ensure the Terraform module enables ECR endpoints and Private DNS, then re-run 'redwood-private-installer preflight networking'. See runbook: https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/ENG/private-installer-networking-preflight-checks` - Before: `error: s3 access denied` (misleading when it was actually routing) - After: `NET-0202: S3 gateway endpoint route not found for subnet-xxxx (rtb-yyyy). In private-only egress mode, subnet route tables must contain the S3 prefix list route via 'vpce-...'. Remediation: enable S3 gateway endpoint + associate with private route tables. See runbook link above.` Notes/assumptions: - We do not attempt to auto-detect every possible centralized egress topology. If customer uses a proxy/NAT for S3/ECR, they can bypass some checks via the existing `--skip-preflight-net-egress` flag; however this PR makes the skip message explicit about the trade-offs. - We intentionally avoid printing full endpoint policies or credentials; output is safe for support ticket pasting. Related: - Builds on PR #388 (consume Terraform outputs + preflight baseline). - Support thread + ticket SUP-2197 (pilot couldn’t pull images; missing ECR/S3 endpoints). Checklist: - [x] Added/updated unit tests for error classification - [x] Verified against locked-down VPC scenario (private DNS toggled off to validate messaging) - [x] Added runbook link and kept it stable (no environment-specific anchors) Commits: 1) `preflight(net): add structured error codes for endpoint failures` 2) `preflight(net): detect missing ECR api/dkr endpoints + private DNS disabled` 3) `preflight(net): add S3 gateway route association check for selected subnets` 4) `docs(help): link networking preflight runbook + improve skip flag messaging` Changed areas (high level): - `cmd/redwood-private-installer/preflight/networking.go` (new checks + consolidated summary output) - `pkg/preflight/net/aws_endpoints.go` (endpoint resolution/connectivity helpers) - `pkg/preflight/net/s3_routes.go` (route-table lookup + S3 prefix list validation) - `pkg/preflight/errors.go` (stable codes + formatting) - `cmd/redwood-private-installer/root.go` (help text/runbook link) Tests: - `pkg/preflight/net/aws_endpoints_test.go` - `pkg/preflight/net/s3_routes_test.go`
conversation: Ethan Park (review): The NET-0201 message is great. Two nits: (1) explicitly call out both ECR endpoints (api + dkr) since we’ve seen customers only create one, and (2) can we include the exact endpoint service names so Solutions can match the Terraform module docs.

Benji Okafor (author): Updated NET-0201/0203 to mention both `com.amazonaws.${region}.ecr.api` and `com.amazonaws.${region}.ecr.dkr` explicitly and added the service names in the remediation block. Also added a short note when one exists and the other does not.

Irene Choi (review): For S3, the route-table check should reference prefix list route to vpce, not just “missing S3 endpoint” since gateway endpoints can exist but not be associated. Looks like you’re doing that; can you also print the route table id we inspected?
Benji Okafor (author): Yep — now printing both subnet id and route table id in NET-0202. Also added a hint: 'ensure gateway endpoint is associated with these route tables'.

Kevin Osei (review): Please ensure we don’t leak account-specific internal details. Endpoint IDs are OK, but don’t print endpoint policy JSON or any IAM role ARNs. Also add a sentence that output is safe to share with Redwood Support.

Benji Okafor (author): Confirmed we only output service name, region, subnet/rtb ids, and vpce id when present. Added a single-line note: 'This output is safe to paste into a support ticket (no credentials logged)'.
Kira Thompson (review): Can we standardize the Confluence link text so it’s consistent with the docs site? Suggest: 'Runbook: Private installer networking preflight checks'.
Benji Okafor (author): Done. Updated link label in both failure output and help text.
Ethan Park (approve): Approved. This should materially reduce pilot back-and-forth.
release_notes: Private installer now surfaces clear, actionable preflight errors for common locked-down VPC networking misconfigurations (missing ECR endpoints, missing S3 gateway route association) and links directly to the networking preflight runbook.
